verdict.rationale: Meltano's docs say it supports scheduled pipelines orchestrated with Apache Airflow, and `meltano run` executes the EL(T) pipelines being scheduled. Recurring execution therefore depends on an external orchestrator rather than a self-contained native scheduler. missing for 10: detailed documentation of schedule definition (cron syntax, schedule config/CLI commands), evidence of scheduling without Airflow, scheduling of non-ELT workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduling works.
